desc:
🛣️ The highway is yours. Floor it past 300 km/h, thread the gaps between traffic and see how long you can keep the run alive without a scratch!

💰 Code: RELEASE

🏎️ 32 cars, from cheap hatchbacks to 1,200 HP hypercars
🔥 Score points for close calls: near misses build your chain, one touch ends it
🏆 Your best run shows on your nametag
🏁 Join race meets on the interstate
🎨 Make it yours with paint finishes, rims, tints & underglow
💵 Every second behind the wheel pays cash: go faster, earn more
📅 Come back daily for rewards worth up to $160,000

📉 Low FPS? Turn the graphics down in ⚙️ Settings or drive in a free private server.
